messages.content:
Three independent readers read the same non-disclosure agreement (NDA) and decided whether it supports one statement (the hypothesis). They may agree or disagree, and a program has checked each of their quotes against the document. Your job is to make the final decision yourself, from the document.

<document>
<document 401 omitted, sha256 929de42283d8b5e2>
</document>

<hypothesis>
Confidential Information shall only include technical information.
</hypothesis>

<readings>
<reading id="A">
label: Contradiction
confidence: 95
reason: The document's defined term Proprietary Information expressly covers business, financial, customer and product development plans and any third-party information, not only technical information, so the hypothesis is false.
<quote check="exact">business plans, and other technical, business, financial, customer and product development plans</quote>
<quote check="exact">Proprietary Information also includes any information</quote>
</reading>
<reading id="B">
label: Contradiction
confidence: 90
reason: The definition of Proprietary Information expressly covers business, financial and customer information as well as technical information, so it is not limited to technical information.
<quote check="exact">and other technical, business, financial, customer and product development plans, forecasts, strategies and information</quote>
</reading>
<reading id="C">
label: Contradiction
confidence: 92
reason: Proprietary Information expressly includes business, financial, and customer information in addition to technical information, so it is not limited to technical information.
<quote check="exact">relationships with other businesses, business plans, and other technical, business, financial, customer and product development plans, forecasts, strategies and information</quote>
</reading>
</readings>

The readings are evidence about where to look, not votes: a majority can be wrong, and a quote marked "missing" was not found in the document. Read the relevant parts of the document yourself.

Choose exactly one label:
- Entailment: the document states or clearly implies that the hypothesis is true.
- Contradiction: the document states or clearly implies that the hypothesis is false.
- NotMentioned: the document does not address the hypothesis, or says too little to decide.

Evidence is required. For Entailment or Contradiction, give 1 to 3 quotes copied character for character from the document (no paraphrase, no ellipses), each as short as it can be while still carrying the point. They will be checked against the document. For NotMentioned, give an empty list.

Give a confidence from 0 to 100: your probability, in percent, that your label is correct. Give a one-sentence reason.

Answer only with the JSON object the response format asks for: label, confidence, quotes, reason.

content.text: {"label": "Contradiction", "confidence": 93, "quotes": ["and other technical, business, financial, customer and product development plans, forecasts, strategies and information"], "reason": "The definition of Proprietary Information expressly covers business, financial and customer information as well as technical information, so it is not limited to technical information."}
